description:
Search Spain's national open-data catalogue (datos.gob.es) for datasets on a topic.

    Returns each dataset's title, publisher, licence, file formats, update frequency and last
    change, and an id to pass to read_dataset. Use when a question needs data this server does
    not hold directly (parking, licences, local events, tourist offices, transport).

place.description: Optional place; datasets about it are preferred.
place.title: Place

name: find_datasets

Source.description: Where a figure comes from. Every number in `data` must trace to one of these.

data_period.description: Reference date or year of the data, e.g. '2025-01-01' or '2023'.
data_period.title: Data Period

dataset_id.description: Upstream identifier, e.g. INE table id '29005'.
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

publisher.description: Organisation that publishes the data, e.g. 'INE'.
publisher.title: Publisher

retrieved_at.description: When this server fetched the data from upstream (UTC).
retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

url.description: URL a person can open to see the data.
url.title: Url

Source.title: Source

confidence.description: Lowest confidence across inputs: high, medium or low. Never state a conclusion more strongly than this.
confidence.title: Confidence

title: Find open datasets
